task.description: 1. Add one sentence to invoke/4's @doc (or the moduledoc, whichever reads more naturally) explicitly naming Letflow.Engine.PluginInterface.invoke/2,3 and citing decision 0014, stating that invoke/4 mirrors (without reusing the code of) that function's own two-layer dispatch pattern (async_nolink -> Task.yield/2 -> Task.shutdown(:brutal_kill)) -- match the design's own SS3 language closely. 2. acceptance_criteria: invoke/4's documentation explicitly names PluginInterface.invoke/2,3 and decision 0014, describing the mirrored (not reused) dispatch pattern
start_link/1 threads a caller-supplied :name option through via Keyword.get(opts, :name, __MODULE__) instead of hardcoding __MODULE__
